[DATE].  
Mild mucoid degeneration is present within both menisci, but with no associated tears being demonstrated.  Focal grade 3/4 articular cartilage loss is noted at the junction of the central and posterior thirds of the medial femoral condyle, best appreciated in the sagittal plane. Tricompartmental articular cartilage surfaces are otherwise well preserved.  
Moderate suprapatellar effusion of a nonspecific nature, there are no intra-articular loose bodies.  Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments, popliteus, extensor tendons and distal iliotibial band. No fracture or marrow infiltration. Grossly unremarkable remaining imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: left knee pain. Clinical concern for ACL tear.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal high-grade fissuring medial patellar facet with subchondral bone marrow edema. Focal high-grade chondrosis central trochlea with subchondral bone marrow edema.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 9 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Mild patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküste grade I dejenerasyon izlenmiştir. Medial menisküs ekstrüde görünümdedir. Medial menisküste grade III dejenerasyon , kök ve kompleks yırtık ile uyumlu görünüm mevcuttur.Ön çapraz bağda mukoid dejenerasyon ile uyumlu sinyal artışı mevcuttur. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir. Medial kollateral ligaman çevresinde sıvı artışı izlenmiştir. Medial ve lateral reseslerde sıvı artışı mevcuttur.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Patellar kemikte subkondral skleroz bulguları, medial fasette kıkırdakta bütünlük kaybı, ayrıca komşu kemikte subkondral milimetrik kist ve ödem ile uyumlu görünüm mevcuttur (tip 4 kondromalazi ).Suprapatellar bursada sıvı artışı, diz eklemi seviyesinde sıvı artışı izlenmiştir.Diz eklemini oluşturan femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda subkondral skleroz bulguları mevcuttur. Ayrıca tibia medial plato düzeyinde arka çapraz bağ yapışma lokalizasyonunda ve femur interkondiler düzeyde ve lateral kondil düzeyinde subkondral ödem ve milimetrik kistler ile uyumlu görünüm mevcuttur.Diz eklemi çevresindeki çevre yumuşak dokularda cilt altı ödematöz görünüm mevcuttur.Gastroknemius medial kruris bacağında tendonda tendinozis ile uyumlu sinyal artışı mevcuttur.

[DATE]: MR Knie Rechts 15ch AA: Klinische inlichtingen: Zie gescande aanvraag Diagnostische vraagstelling: Zie gescande aanvraag Bevindingen: Matig tot gevorderd mediaal femorotibiaal kraakbeenlijden, met quasi volledig kraakbeenverlies op het dragende deel van de mediale femorale condyl en het tibiaplateau, gepaard gaand met kleine subchondrale geode's, marginale osteofytose. Degeneratief voorkomen mediale meniscus met onregelmatige aflijning, echter zonder duidelijke scheur . Beginnend tot matig lateraal femorotibiaal kraakbeenlijden, met oppervlakkige en diepe fissuren. Matige opzetting van suprapatellaire recessus. Beginnend tot matig femoropatellair kraakbeenlijden met oppervlakkige en diepe fissuren. Popliteale cyste, met craniocaudale as 6\~cm. Normaal voorkomen verschillende pezen. Besluit: Beginnende gonartrose van de rechterknie met beginnend tot matig tot gevorderd kraakbeenlijden graad 2, 3 en 4, in alle 3 compartimenten, op heden met matige hydrops.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain for 2 weeks after rugby injury.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Severe osseous contusions at the medial and lateral femoral condyles and posterolateral and posteromedial tibial plateau. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small, ruptured Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Complex tear of the posterior horn. No extrusion or displaced fragment.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Complete midsubstance tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Grade 1 sprain.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Grade 1 sprain of the fibular collateral ligament. Normal distal iliotibial band, popliteus tendon, and biceps femoris tendon.
Posterolateral corner structures: Grade 1 soleus strain.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Recent pivot shift mechanism injury with complete ACL tear, pivot shift pattern osseous contusions, grade 1 sprain of the medial and fibular collateral ligaments, and grade 1 strain of the soleus.
2.	Complex tear of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.

MRI of right Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS



> The contour of ACL is in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 injury or mucoid degeneration.
> The contour of PCL appears to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of  grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration or  peripheral prominent vascularity.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis and bulging lateral aspect synovial recess over popliteal fossa.
> Wearing of articular cartilage of right knee, especially at patellar  ridge and femoral trochlea with subchondral edema over femoral trochlea, reflecting grade 4 chondromalacia of patellofemoral joint
> Patellar enthesophyte and mild tendinosis of quadriceps tendon and patellar tendon.

Impression: 
1. Grade 4 chondromalacia of right patellofemoral joint, reflecting osteoarthritis.
2. Synovitis of right knee with suprapatellar bursitis and patellar plicae.
3. Grade 1 injury or mucoid degeneration of ACL.
4. Grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, R/O degeneration or  peripheral prominent vascularity.
5. Patellar enthesophyte with mild adjacent tendinosis.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Oberflächliche Knorpelirregularitäten in der Belastungszone der medialen Femurcondyle. Kein fokal tiefgreifender oder vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. Kein subchondrales Knochenödem. Radiärer Riss des Innenmeniskushinterhorns. Intaktes MCL.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Außenmeniskus. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Oberflächliche Knorpelirregularitäten im mittleren Patellafirst. Kein fokal tiefgreifender oder vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. Kein subchondrales Knochenödem. Regelrechte Darstellung der Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Alte VKB-Ruptur. Mehrere kleine Zysten an der tibialen Insertion des VKB. Intaktes HKB.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Geringer Gelenkerguss. Flüssigkeitsgefüllte Baker-Zyste.

Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colateral lateral sin alteraciones. Leve engrosamiento de baja señal del
componente superficial del ligamento colateral medial con discreto edema de las partes blandas
adyacentes. El resto de los componentes dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal marginal del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco medial con mínima
extrusión. El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Úlceras condrales superficiales del cóndilo femoral medial. El resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales
y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y prácticamente total
de la rótula de distribución difusa, sin cambios óseos secundarios.
Mínimo derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Leve aumento de señal en inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital. Tendón rotuliano, tendones de
la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales. El trayecto de los
principales nervios mediano presenta alteraciones significativas con especial del CPE.
Impresión:
Engrosamiento que impresiona secuelar del componente superficial del ligamento colateral medial
con edema de las partes blandas regionales.
Fibrilación marginal del cuerpo y cuerno posterior del menisco medial con mínima extrusión.
Condropatía lesiones grado 1 y 2 del cóndilo femoral medial.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 y 3 de la rótula.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs ve medial menisküsler eklem aralığından ekstrude olup menisküslerde belirgin hacim kaybı, maserasyon ve grade III dejenerasyonlar izlendi. Anterior çapraz bağda komplet rüptüre sekonder bütünlük kaybı izlenmektedir. Posterior çapraz bağ belirgin kıvrımlı görünümdedir. Diz eklemini oluşturan her 3 kompartmanda santral-marjinal osteofit formasyonu izlendi. Tibiofemoral eklem medial ve lateralinde eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu kemik yüzlerde subkondrial skleroz, ödem ve milimetrik kistler izlendi. Bu düzeyde femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda destrüksiyon izlendi. Bulgular dejeneratif artrit lehine yorumlandı.Diz eklemi posteriorunda, popliteus tendon kılıf komşuluğunda snovial sıvının çevrelediği büyüğü 7 mm çaplı ossifiye nodüler lezyonlar izlendi. Bulgular snovial kondromatozis lehine yorumlanmıştır. Diz eklem kapsülü posterior superiorunda yırtık, yırtık ile ilişikli 2.5x1.5 cm boyutlu ganglion kisti izlendi. Diz eklem posteriorunda 3x2 cm boyutlu ekstraartiküler ganglion kisti izlenmektedir. Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde sıvı artışı izlendi. Tibianın tibiafibular eklemden anteriora doğru sublüksasyonu izlenmektedir. Patella lateral fasette kartilaj belirgin incelmiştir. Sonuç: Gonartroz.Medial ve lateral menisküslerde ekstrüzyon, volüm kaybı, maserasyon ve grade IIII meniskopati.Anterior çapraz bağda komplet rüptür ve posterior çapraz bağda kıvrımlı görünüm.Medial kollateral ligamende grade I sprain. Diz eklem  kapsülü posteriorunda yırtık ve yırtık ile ilişkili ganglion kistleri.Suprapatellar bursit ve diz ekleminde sinovit.Tibianın sublüksasyonu.Patella lateral fasette grade II kondromalazi.
